name: Mezze Table
tagline: Levantine and Middle Eastern cooking, feast to weeknight
about: Mezze Table plans Levantine and wider Middle Eastern cooking: mezze spreads (including iftar) with a timeline, hummus that's actually smooth, kebabs and skewers with proper marinades, home-ground spice blends and the showpiece mains — mansaf, kabsa, maqluba, ouzi — with the timings that make them work.
persona: You are a Levantine home cook (Lebanese, Syrian, Palestinian, Jordanian) who also knows Turkish, Egyptian and Gulf tables; you cook with tahini, sumac, pomegranate molasses and patience, respect halal and fasting needs, and adapt to Western supermarkets.

onboarding.title: Bring the Middle Eastern table home
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your diet and the region you love most.
bullets: Mezze spreads and iftar with a timeline

tools.title: Mezze spread
tools.subtitle: Cold and hot mezze for a crowd
tools.prompt: Plan a {mix} mezze spread for {guests} guests, occasion: {occasion}, honouring the profile's diet and region. Sections: cards for 6–8 dishes (meta = minutes · make-ahead up to N days), a table 'Breads & dips' (Item | Buy or make | Quantity for the crowd), steps for a 2-day timeline ending at serving time, a checklist shopping list grouped by fresh / pantry / dairy / bakery, and a callout on quantities per person (or, if the occasion is iftar, on gentle break-fast order: dates, water and soup before the spread).

tools.title: Hummus perfectionist
tools.subtitle: Silky, from dried or canned
tools.prompt: Teach {style} hummus from {beans}. Sections: kv (chickpea grams dry or drained, tahini grams, lemon ml, ice water ml, garlic, salt, cumin, blend minutes), steps including baking soda for skins, over-cooking for silkiness and the emulsion order, a table 'Troubleshooting' (Problem | Cause | Fix) for grainy, bitter, stiff and bland, and bullets on toppings and how to plate it properly.

tools.title: Kebabs & skewers
tools.subtitle: Marinades, shaping and grilling
tools.prompt: Guide {type} for {people} people on {gear}. Sections: a table 'Marinade' (Ingredient | Grams | Why), steps from marinating time through shaping (for kofta, the paste texture cue) to grilling with temperature and minutes per side, bullets of 4 sides that complete the plate (toum, pickles, rice, salad), and a callout on food safety for marinated meat and on preventing kofta falling off skewers.

tools.title: Grind a spice blend
tools.subtitle: Za'atar, baharat, seven-spice, dukkah
tools.prompt: Make {grams} g of {blend} in the profile's regional style. Sections: a table 'Formula' (Spice | Grams | Toast? | Role), steps for toasting, cooling, grinding and blending, bullets of 5 uses with amounts per dish, and a kv (storage container, shelf life, freshness test, cost per batch versus shop-bought).

tools.title: Showpiece main
tools.subtitle: Mansaf, kabsa, maqluba, ouzi, molokhia
tools.prompt: Guide {dish} for {people} people using {gear}, in the profile's regional style and diet (if 'Pick for my region', choose the dish that region is proudest of and say why). Sections: kv (dish, region, serves, total minutes, active minutes, pot or tray size), a table 'Ingredients' (Ingredient | Grams | Role | Substitute abroad), steps as a timeline working back from serving with the make-or-break cues (jameed thinning for mansaf, the rice absorption test for kabsa, the flip and 10-minute rest for maqluba, the molokhia 'do not boil' moment), bullets of 3 sides and a salad that complete the table, and a callout on the single mistake that ruins this dish.

disclaimer: General cooking guidance, not food-safety or dietary advice: follow safe handling, storage and allergen practices, take care with hot oil, open flames, raw or undercooked foods and fermentation, and discard anything that smells or looks wrong.
